why_not: The page lists online shops at 2% per card payment plus a 1% BankPay commission charged to the company, but the actual fee for a small shop depends on the shop type, and the self-employed tier says only 'Індивідуальний тариф' (individual tariff), and the BankPay split and the 2.5% invoicing tier with a buyer-paid fee add cases the owner must sort through, so a single line would not be accurate for every shop.
